issue_request: FHIR-17683 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I technical correction for the FHIR-core BaseResource page. It asked that the Resource Boundaries and Relationships sentence use singular link text 'DomainResource' instead of the plural typo 'Domain Resources'.
initial_application: The Jira comment records application as 'svn 14832'. Git commit 0bad35837addc6c6c07c5e5cf63b23ee04ba1d89, 'GF#17683 - fix typo', changed source/resource/resource-introduction.xml from 'Domain Resources' to 'DomainResource' on 2018-08-15.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps Resource active as a type page and abstract resource infrastructure, so source/resource/resource-introduction.xml is current-build source. The original paragraph was later rewritten by 146c14f37fbb1b43d6987f6f425b887dfc2a0fcb, and the combined branch's FHIR-19569 reconciliation corrected that later wording's separate 'recources' typo without reintroducing the FHIR-17683 plural typo. Zulip search found only the original tracker bot notification, and Confluence searches found no relevant FHIR-17683 reference or conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current active Resource paragraph already says 'DomainResource' and no remaining relevant 'Domain Resources' typo was found.
